snippet.title: Toward The Ice - Gameplay Demo (December 2025)
snippet.description:
Gameplay demo of the Toward The Ice grid-based dungeon crawler currently in development by Dragon Dropper.

Built with a classic gameplay style reminiscent of The Bard's Tale, Wizardry, and Might and Magic, this RPG is planned for release in May 2026.

Soundtrack by Bloodless Mushroom.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878110/Toward_The_Ice/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demo25_12&utm_content=demo25_12
